title: ConversationResponse
description: Proposal how the inhabitant reacts to the player's text. outcome: reply = says something (reply set); gesture = only a body expression (low understanding); not_understood = the core opens a question to the AI with a question mark (W1595, B2487); decline = does not want to answer. The core checks reply text with the content guard and may still reject it.

tick.description: Echo of the request tick; the core discards stale responses.

reply.description: Speech bubble in display_locale. Set for reply; since conversation prompt v2 (Marcel W1701) also for decline and not_understood (the inhabitant says no or asks back; a stand-in msg.converse.<outcome> when the model gives none). Null for gesture.

expression.description: Optional body expression id from the expression vocabulary; unknown ids are dropped by the core.

rationale.description: Short English reasoning for logs and the debug view. Never shown to the player.

voice.description: What the player's text IS (A1538, B6 R21, D891): naming a thing in sight or praise, from the vocabulary voice_kind. Only when the inhabitant understood (outcome reply or gesture) and the service's checks passed: a named type is one the speaker sees, the word stands in the player's text and passes the content guard. Never what follows - the core decides the effect from its data. Absent or null otherwise, and from an older service.

naming.description: Only with kind naming: the type of the thing (a plain type id of speaker.sees) and the word as the player wrote it (1-3 words). The same word in both languages: it is the inhabitant's own word, not a translation.
